falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score rises above 60 within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score exceeding 60 would confirm a blowoff phase, directly contradicting the current HOLD signal and UNKNOWN verdict.

falsification_conditions.condition: The price closes above the 200-day moving average by 5% or more within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a breakout would indicate a confirmed trend reversal, invalidating the pattern's similarity to a bottom formation (bottom_2024_aug).

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume spikes to 200% above the 30-day average on two consecutive days within the 14-day window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This level of volume would signal extreme market participation, falsifying the HOLD signal by indicating a high-probability breakout or blowoff event.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
